purpose: Phone nights with an established office seed, replayed into the rebuilt runtime on the phone's own frame clock (phone-encounter-replay.mjs). Private inputs (artifacts/, captures/) are named by path under the main checkout and by sha256; nothing here is a frame, a recording or game data.

binary.pinned: pinned/7ab9a755-7163d628 in the external recompile directory
binary.note: 8eb41219 plus CHOWDREN_FRAME_TIMES/_FRAME and CHOWDREN_WATCH_OVERLAP; with neither set it replays grid-screen n6-h's frame/tick/draw/state projection exactly (25,822 updates)

harness.runner: tools/recompile/run-harness.sh (CHOWDREN_BINARY = the pinned binary), CHOWDREN_HARNESS=1, CHOWDREN_NO_DRAW=1
harness.env: the RUNDIR/env lines emit writes: seed, stop at 06-next day, 40000 total updates, the three watches, and the measured clock

landed.what: the phone's frame trace with Fusion's catch-up; each press on the pass that drew the frame it landed in: send plus the night's measured landing latency

sched.what: the same clock; each press on the frame of its send (no landing latency)

cum.what: the same clock; presses by the model encounter records' rule (t after the seed on the update clock, mid-update)

raw.what: one update per captured frame, no catch-up; presses landed

const60.what: a constant 60 Hz clock, as a night with no trace runs; presses by the cum rule on it

landed-r20.what: landed presses; releases 20 ms after their send (docs/evidence/phone-release-latency-20261001.json)
